claim: Correctness repair of the v2 evaluation protocol: semantics-preserving input anonymisation, fixed target-paired and fixed-control denominator accounting, and explicit abandonment of self-selected clean-control subsets. Deterministic predictions are reused byte-identically from v2. No real API call.

deterministic_predictions_reused.policy: byte-identical reuse after verifying the frozen v2 artifact hash; no scorer or panel change

evaluation_protocol.control_scope: all 40 frozen target-field controls for every method (no per-method subset selection)
evaluation_protocol.control_self_consistency: diagnostic only; not an independent global-compliance label

unknown_policy.variant_unknown: counted as FN; also reported separately as FN_unknown
unknown_policy.control_unknown: reported separately; does not enter the decided TNR denominator
unknown_policy.pair_success: variant positive AND control negative over all pairs
